Per the hard-block rule, all further requests to jossandmain.com were stopped immediately. The 3 Bathroom furniture leaves (Bathroom Vanities, Bathroom Storage, Medicine Cabinets) could not have their qty verified and are recorded with qty:null + MANUAL REVIEW flags. All other 50 furniture leaves across Furniture and Outdoor departments were fully verified before the block occurred.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.jossandmain.com/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow, only allows /sb0|sb1|sb2/ and disallows other /sb*/ paths plus various account/checkout/filter paths -- none blocking. Opened entirely via the Claude-in-Chrome connector in one dedicated tab, no other route used. TAXONOMY SOURCE: Joss & Main runs the same Next.js/BlockBuilderBrowse platform as Wayfair/AllModern/Birch Lane (confirmed by prior Home-Decor pass notes for this SR). The furniture tree was built from three cross-checked sources per brief Trap #1: (1) the site's own global mega-menu (present in the DOM on every page, walked via anchor extraction over multiple page loads with a localStorage accumulator keyed w203_sb to dedupe across navigations), (2) the /furniture/cat/ and /outdoor/cat/ and /bathroom/cat/ mid-level 'cat' pages, several of which carry their own additional child sb0 leaves not present in the mega-menu (Accent Chairs+Chaise Lounges under Accent & Lounge Chairs; Sleeper Sofas+Daybeds under Sleepers & Daybeds; Coffee Tables+Coffee Table Sets under Coffee Tables & Sets; Ottomans+Accent & Vanity Stools under Ottomans/Poufs/Stools; China Cabinets+Pantry Cabinets+Baker's Racks under China & Pantry Cabinets; Dining Chairs+Dining Benches under Dining Chairs & Benches; Armoires & Wardrobes under Dressers & Armoires -- this last cat page is not linked from the mega-menu at all), and (3) the seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (166 /cat/ URLs total) used to confirm no additional furniture-relevant department/subcategory branch was missed. Two nodes turned out to be true leaves themselves despite having /cat/ URLs and no further children: Entryway & Hallway Furniture (qty confirmed via rendered 'Items 1 through 5 of 5' header, a different phrasing than the sb0 pages' 'N Items' badge) and Bar & Bar Carts (qty via the same 'N Items' badge as sb0 leaves, needed 3 retries because of tool-side stale-cache reads, not a site issue). QTY METHOD: rendered listing-header 'N Items' badge (or 'Items X through Y of Z' on the two /cat/-only leaves), read via the accessibility-tree find tool. The find tool intermittently returned a cached/stale value from the previous page after a fast navigate (confirmed by seeing values repeat verbatim from the prior leaf, or the accessible-tree ref id staying identical); every suspicious repeat was re-queried once more and the fresh value used -- this is noted per-row only where it mattered; final numbers below are all confirmed fresh reads matching the page's own h1/title. SANITY CHECKS: numbers vary node-to-node (no constant site-wide value seen), none are suspiciously round, h1/tab-title matched the intended node on every accepted read, two independent reads obtained for values that first looked like tool-cache artifacts. EXCLUSIONS: Mattresses (bedding, appears in Bedroom Furniture menu but filed at /bedding/sb0/ -- not furniture). Vanity Mirrors, Bathroom Fixtures & Hardware, Bath Linens & Accessories, Cabinet & Drawer Knobs/Pulls, Toilet Paper Holders, Towel Bars/Rings, Bathroom Faucets/Sinks, Tubs & Whirlpools (bathroom fixtures/hardware/textiles, not furniture). Outdoor Lighting (Wall/Hanging/Flush/String lights, Post Lanterns) and Patio Decor & Accessories (Fire Pits, Planters, Outdoor Furniture Cushions, Outdoor Pillows, Outdoor Rugs, Doormats, Outdoor Plant Stands, Patio Furniture Covers, Patio Umbrellas) -- lighting/decor/textiles, not furniture. 'All Outdoor Tables' dropped as a pure roll-up duplicating Outdoor Dining Tables + Outdoor Coffee & Accent Tables (hierarchy rule -- parent carries no qty once children are captured). The 'Storage' top-level department (Storage by Product, Storage by Room, and the storage/cat/storage-cabinets-c1859164 page) was walked and found to be a cross-cutting merchandising overlay with zero unique sb0 children beyond what the Furniture department already exposes (Bookcases & Bookshelves, Room Dividers) plus purely non-furniture Baskets/Bins/Boxes and Wall Shelves -- not re-listed to avoid duplicate rows. The three 'outdoor-furniture-by-material' cat pages (Wicker/Metal/Teak Outdoor Furniture) are cross-cut-by-material views of the same type-based Outdoor sb0 leaves already captured (confirmed no unique children); dropped as duplicate paths. Organizational Furniture's Bookcases & Bookshelves and Filing Cabinets children are the identical sb0 nodes already listed once under Living Room Furniture and Home Office Furniture respectively -- listed once, not duplicated. No kids/nursery-furniture department exists on this site. Category bucket 'Outdoor Furniture' and 'Bathroom Furniture' used per brief's allowance for a more-truthful department name (site nav calls these departments 'Outdoor' and 'Bath', which mix furniture with lighting/textiles/fixtures).
